intro: Notes on books I am reading and questions I have not solved yet. When an entry is my own opinion rather than a summary of a source, I mark it.
description: I have no formal training in philosophy. Disagreements and corrections are welcome.

thinkers.name: J. Krishnamurti
thinkers.description: I am reading Krishnamurti on self-observation and mental habits, specifically his idea that the observer is the observed.

thinkers.name: Albert Camus
thinkers.description: I am reading Camus on the conflict between human expectation and an indifferent universe.

thinkers.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
thinkers.description: I read Dostoevsky for his psychological details on guilt, free will, and moral decisions.

thinkers.name: Ramana Maharshi
thinkers.description: I am interested in Ramana Maharshi's self-inquiry method of asking 'Who am I?' as a practical test rather than a doctrine.

thinkers.name: Osho
thinkers.description: I read Osho to test my own assumptions against strong arguments, even when his historical or factual claims are unreliable.

notesIntro: Short entries on books and questions.
notesDescription: Not every note becomes an essay.
